348.text: a dark - brown velvet jacket with a high , black , linen - lined collar

quotes.text: "in the name of human charity! A room and a fire!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Can I take your hat and coat,
sir?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "and give them a good dry in the kitchen?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"_As_ you like. In a bit the room will
be warmer."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "There! I clean forgot it. It's her being so long!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I suppose I may
have them to dry now,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "I'll have them nicely dried, sir, at once,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "The poor soul's had an accident or an op'ration or somethin',"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "What a turn them bandages did give me, to be sure!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"And they goggles! Why, he looked
more like a divin' helmet than a human man!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"And holding that handkerchief over his
mouth all the time. Talkin' through it! ... Perhaps his mouth was
hurt too--maybe."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "It's a steep road by the down, sir,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"It was there a carriage was upsettled, a year ago
and more. A gentleman killed, besides his coachman. Accidents, sir,
happen in a moment, don't they?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown
